inference: For the exact modeled scheme, role-local checkpoint progress and logical-effect claim admission are separate state machines. An UNKNOWN_RESULT pending effect can coexist with a newer LATEST checkpoint; safe recovery requires an evidence-bearing terminal pending resolution before a new effect identity may be derived. This narrows the next empirical target but does not prove connector-level exactly-once, atomic create-if-absent, mutual exclusion, fairness, lease expiry, or real rate-limit behavior.
